correctness.rationale: For all integers m>=2, the explicitly defined quadratic lambda_m makes Z_lambda terminal branch image exactly I0 (even m) or I1..Im (odd m). All other branches cover [0,1]. The transfer identity S_j(n)=lambda^-(n-1) 1^T A_j^(n-1) lengths follows from disjoint word-cylinder interiors and common slope. Matrices for j>=1 are related by permutation; hole 0 has strictly smaller/larger terminal row than the other matrices depending on m parity, with positive paths proving strict inequalities for every n>=2. Perron eigenvalues follow from two-variable eigen-equations, with special j=0 rank-one or nilpotent structure. Uniform expansion and finite-type coding establish entropy and Hausdorff dimension including zero-entropy m=2 case. Direct interval preimage and spectral checks embedded in check.py ran successfully m=2..8; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 motivating arXiv full text proves entropy/exactness for closed zigzag maps but does not describe single-lap holes. Haritha--Agarwal full arXiv text covers general Markov-hole transfer machinery and known equal-measure unequal-escape examples on product maps, without the postcritical zigzag metallic sequence or its all-n parity ordering. Bandtlow--Rugh full arXiv text gives general hole-entropy continuity, without these exact formulas. published-finding corpus search found negative-doubling and moving-hole findings on different maps; none has an implication furnishing the two metallic characteristic polynomials and parity switch for all m. The general method is prior work, and this assessment does not certify exhaustive historical priority.

value.rationale: An infinite naturally selected postcritical family has an exact, all-horizon ranking of equal-length holes reversing with the parity of the number of full laps. It simultaneously determines escape clocks, survivor entropy and Hausdorff dimension and shows all non-leftmost positions are indistinguishable despite different locations. The parity switch is not a generic consequence of equal size, and it provides a structural benchmark for location-dependent leakage rather than an arbitrary isolated calculation.
